pages.title: Welcome to Solbay Wholesale
pages.description: Who we work with and how wholesale works.
pages.md:
# Welcome to Solbay Wholesale

Solbay makes leather goods, outdoor gear and kitchen classics that are built to be carried for years. We sell them online and through a small group of independent shops and concept stores in Europe and North America.

This guide explains how to become a stockist, how ordering works, and what to expect from shipping and invoicing.

## What you get as a stockist

- Wholesale prices at **50% off** our retail price
- Our full line sheet, updated every season
- Product photos and copy you are free to use in your own shop
- A dedicated contact on our wholesale team

pages.title: Becoming a stockist
pages.md:
# Becoming a stockist

We look for shops whose customers care about well-made things, and we keep a limited number of stockists per city.

## Requirements

- A physical shop, or an online shop with its own brand and website
- A first order of at least **EUR 1,500**
- Agreement to sell at our recommended retail prices

## How to apply

1. Open the chat on solbay and choose **Wholesale inquiry**, or write to our wholesale team.
2. Tell us about your shop: location, website, and the brands you carry.
3. We reply within two business days with our line sheet and wholesale prices.

pages.title: Your wholesale account
pages.description: Logging in and finding your price list.
pages.md:
# Your wholesale account

Once you are approved, we create a wholesale account for you. Log in with the same email address you applied with.

In your account you will find:

- The current **line sheet** with wholesale and retail prices
- Your **order history** and invoices
- **Stock levels** for every product, updated hourly

pages.title: Placing an order
pages.description: Minimums, reorders and the line sheet.
pages.md:
# Placing an order

Your **first order** must be at least **EUR 1,500**. Reorders have no minimum.

1. Pick the products and quantities from the line sheet.
2. Send the order from your wholesale account, or email it to your contact.
3. We confirm availability and the shipping date within one business day.

> Leather products are made in small batches. For orders over 50 pieces of one item, ask us about lead times first.

pages.title: Lead times
pages.description: How long production and packing take.
pages.md:
# Lead times

| Collection | Usual lead time |
| --- | --- |
| Leather goods | 2 to 3 weeks |
| Outdoor and footwear | 1 week |
| Kitchen | 1 week |

Items in stock ship within 3 business days. We tell you the exact date when we confirm your order.

pages.title: Payment terms
pages.md:
# Payment terms

- **First order:** paid in advance by bank transfer or card.
- **Following orders:** net 30 days from the invoice date.

We accept bank transfer (EUR, USD, GBP) and all major cards. Late payments pause new orders until the account is settled.

pages.title: Shipping and delivery
pages.md:
# Shipping and delivery

We ship wholesale orders DAP (delivered at place) with DHL Express or, for large orders, on a pallet with our freight partner.

- Orders over **EUR 3,000** ship free within the EU.
- Below that, shipping is charged at cost and shown on your order confirmation.
- Every parcel has tracking; you receive the link by email when it leaves our warehouse.

pages.title: Invoices and VAT
pages.description: How invoices work in and outside the EU.
pages.md:
# Invoices and VAT

We send the invoice by email on the day your order ships.

- **EU stockists with a valid VAT number:** invoices use the reverse-charge mechanism, so no VAT is added.
- **Stockists outside the EU:** invoices are VAT-free; import duties are paid by the stockist.

pages.title: Damaged goods and returns
pages.description: What to do if something arrives damaged.
pages.md:
# Damaged goods and returns

Please check every delivery within **7 days**. If something is damaged or missing, send us your order number and a photo, and we replace it or credit your account.

Wholesale orders cannot be returned for change of mind, but we are happy to swap slow-moving products for new-season items once a year.
